snapshot.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Management consistently guides for a robust 15% revenue growth for FY26 and 10-12% for FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Reported sales figures validate strong sequential growth reaching up to 82,762 INR crore by Mar 2026.

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Management expresses confidence in maintaining stable margins around 8.5% for P&M.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Reported operating profit margins remain consistently stable near 11% to 13% across quarters.

promises.credibility: Management demonstrates a reliable track record by consistently delivering on their stated revenue and margin targets for FY26.

bull: Revenue shows steady compounding with a 3-year CAGR of 16% matching the 5-year CAGR of 16%.
Profit after tax grew strongly by 27% year-over-year in the latest quarter ending Sep 2026.
Strong cash generation is evident with 5-year cumulative CFO at 1.15x PAT totalling ₹86,099 Cr.
bear: Operating margins are compressing with OPM at 13% compared to the 15% average of prior years.
Latest quarter Sep 2026 EBITDA margin declined by 1.3 percentage points year-over-year to 11.2%.
Debt to equity remains leveraged at 1.24, though it improved slightly from 1.35 three periods ago.
